verdict.rationale: Weave documents a REST Service API for programmatic access, backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec of 117 paths that is described as covering the full service surface and comes with a live Swagger console. Python/TypeScript SDKs and an official MCP server add further programmatic access to traces, evaluations and scorers. Nothing in the evidence states UI/API parity, and the 404s at the docs-site OpenAPI paths are resolved by the working spec on trace.wandb.ai. missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity statement, evidence that Playground, leaderboards, signals and alert/webhook-automation configuration are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.
serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at the well-known path, covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query)
The trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads /openapi.json, a runnable in-page console against the production API
